marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Muscle boy sid and 3 other science explorations

I have muscles where?: When Sid's Dad tells him a really funny joke, Sid laughs so hard that his face hurts. Sid wonders why his face would hurt if the joke was funny? When Sid and his friends investigate at school, they learn that they have muscles all over their bodies, even in their faces!"--Container. "Sod's amazing lungs: Sid races around his room and finds himself breathing really fast. Sid then wonders where all the air is going in his body when he breathes in? At school, Sid and his friends discover that our bodies have lungs to help us breathe in oxgen!"--Container.
"How did my dog do that?: When Sid dog uses his foot to scratch his ear, Sid tries the same maneuver, but can't do it. Sid explores skeletons, and discovers that animals have different bones and joints than people, which allows them to do lots of cool stuff like swing from trees, fly in the air, or even scratch their ears with their feet!"--Container.
"Now that's using your brain: When Sid figures out a new way to get ready for school super fast, Mom says that to him, "Now that's using your brain" Sid wants to know what that means, and discovers that the brain controls all kinds of things like walking, thinking, breathing, and getting ready for school!
